complexity.notes: Clever and concise, but correctness silently breaks if any input string contains the delimiter character "😀"; a length-prefix scheme would be robust to arbitrary content. Using a rare emoji makes collisions unlikely in practice but is still a latent correctness assumption.
complexity.summary: Encodes by joining all strings with an emoji delimiter (plus trailing delimiter) and decodes by splitting on that delimiter and dropping the final empty fragment. Both operations are single linear scans over the total character volume, which scales linearly with the number of strings.
